slots.description: The component content, a set of checkbox items. Items stack in a column by default; for a row, nest them in `<al-layout direction="row" wrap>`.
If content is slotted, it will display in place of the fieldNote property
slots.name: field-note

slots.description: If content is slotted, it will display in place of the errorNote property
slots.name: error

events.name: onCheckboxGroupChange
events.description: Fired when any checkbox in the group changes. Detail: `{ checked, value, checkedValues }` — the state and value of the checkbox that changed, plus the values of every currently-checked checkbox in the group.

isError.description:
Error state
- Changes the component's treatment to represent an error state

isDisabled.description:
Disabled attribute
- Changes the component's treatment to represent a disabled state

isRequired.description:
Required attribute
- Sets the checkbox to be required for validation

hideLegend.description:
Hide legend?
- If true, hides the legend from displaying

errorNote.description:
Error message
- An error field note that displays below the checkbox input

fieldNote.description:
Field note
- The helper text that displays below the checkbox input

fieldId.description:
Id attribute
- The ID used for A11y and to associate the label with the input

ariaDescribedBy.description:
aria-describedby attribute
- Applied to the field note or error note for A11y
